COLOUR IS CONTESTED ACROSS RETAILERS for this same code: violet, transparent purple, cherry and pink all appear. The public colour must be decided from the acquired frames, not from retailer text.

PASS 3 — RESOLUTION UPGRADE AND A SECOND CATALOGUE. Pass 2 acquired ONE image at 800x800 on asset-url evidence, which is below the media policy's three and below the 1000px preference. Two causes, both now fixed generically: the asset URL carried an undecoded & between its parameters, so the second size parameter arrived named 'amp;height' and was ignored; and the size-transform regex covered wid/hei but not the spelled-out width/height a Magento storefront uses, so a larger copy of the same asset was never requested.

COLOUR IS NOW SETTLED BY THE FRAME, and it is not plain pink. The acquired image shows a translucent plum/wine-purple frame with rose-pink lenses and a crystal-set CHOO logo on the temple. Retailer text agrees on the purple reading: eBay via Otticanet says VIOLET, SmartBuyGlasses says Transparent Purple with Pink lenses, Go-Optic says Cherry. Only Jomashop and Timepiece say 'pink'. The public colour must reflect the frame, and the user is to decide the exact wording.
